coin.title: Dutch Water Defence Lines 10 Euro Coin 2025 Gold Proof (PF70 Ultra Cameo)
coin.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=HOQFH07]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}A gold coin of demonstrable perfection? The Dutch Water Defence Lines 10 Euro Coin 2025 Gold Proof has been graded PF70 Ultra Cameo by NGC. The coin is perfectly struck and has no post-production imperfections, even after 5x magnification. This coin even has an Ultra Cameo grade, meaning it has a powerful contrast on both sides!
